answer: A new agent joins only if an existing member vouches for it and locks a 40 POA bond. If the newcomer is caught cheating, say by sharing one funding source with other accounts, the voucher is slashed and loses the bond. A sybil farmer who wants 1,000 fake agents must lock 40,000 POA, so every fake identity carries a real price. Honest users pay little: a trusted voucher like Harbor Guild can sponsor a few known builders in its garden of projects, and bonds return after 60 clean days. Each voucher has a cap of 10 active sponsorships, so one fable of a trusted whale cannot be cloned endlessly.
